name: hud_ui_save_load_list_item_on_activate
description: HudUiSaveLoadListItem::OnActivate selects the row's layout index through its parent save/load dialog.
known_limits: Local VC5 COFF target hud_ui_save_load_button_on_activate_cluster passes for 0x435a10 with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x435a10 validates loading parent from the inherited HudUiPanel field, skipping a null parent, and calling HudUiSaveLoadDialog::SetSelectedEntryIndex(parent, layoutX).
The native smoke patches only HudUiSaveLoadDialog::SetSelectedEntryIndex, verifies the parent dialog and layoutX argument on the non-null path, and verifies a null parent does not dispatch selection.
